alpha_summary_desert<- estimate_richness(Desert_rare_phyloseq, measures = c("Observed", "Shannon"))
Evenness <- evenness(Desert_rare_phyloseq, 'pielou')
alpha_summary_desert$Pielou <- Evenness$pielou
summary(alpha_summary_desert)
alpha_meta_desert <- data.frame(alpha_summary_desert, sample_data(Desert_rare_phyloseq))

cor.test(alpha_meta_desert$Observed, alpha_meta_desert$averagesoiltemperature, method="spearman")
